plan.title: Stage issue view (cockpit): adopt the conversation-first issue view, one view in two shells
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: This issue is already the third slice of an operator-made split (PAN-5244 drawer, PAN-5253 shared view, PAN-5246 Stage flip). The flip is inseparable: the frame rewrite, the deletion of the modules it orphans, the no-loss inventory re-homing and the docs describing the new single view must ship together, or the Stage tab shows two views or the no-loss gate loses sections. The file count is high mainly because eleven orphaned files are deleted and each docs file counts as its own subsystem; the code change itself spans one frontend subtree.

narratives.Problem: The issue drawer and the Stage issue tab (the cockpit) are two different issue views. The cockpit (IssueMissionControl, 930 lines) has its own header, phase rail, six-tab band, crew spine and awareness rail, and uses the shared IssueDetail only for its Session tab. After PAN-5244 and PAN-5253 the shared view carries every cockpit surface in the drawer, so the cockpit's copies are duplicate code and a second layout to maintain.
narratives.Proposal: Make IssueDetail density=page render the same composition as density=drawer and delete its legacy page return; extract the drawer's title row into IssueTitleRow; rewrite IssueMissionControl as a thin Stage frame (title row with breadcrumb and Open tracker, IssueDetail with local tab state, the launch composition as a Details footer). Add the Details next-step line and Create PR link in both shells, put the cockpit section markers on the shared elements and re-point the no-loss inventory homes before the flip, delete the orphaned cockpit modules, re-point the e2e pane test at the Details pipeline table, and update the docs. The corrected PRD at .pan/drafts/pan-5246.md is the implementation brief.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No change to the Command Deck left issue tree (components/CommandDeck/ProjectTree/) or what a click on a session row does, and no change to its Awareness column.
- No change to ConversationPanel internals, its composer or its hidden header actions.
- No change to the rail density (the project-tree row and IssueDetail's rail branch).
- No change to the tab table in issueTabs.ts, the tab bodies, the banner slot's rule, the Checks view or the PAN-5253 Details blocks beyond the WI-3 additions and WI-4 markers.
- No change to the skill row redesign (PAN-5245) or SkillOverridesSections.tsx.
- No opening of a pane-only session's conversation from the issue view.
- No deletion of cockpit modules that were already unmounted before this issue (IssueCockpitBody, OverviewTab, ShipTab, CrewStage, CostCard, CodeCard, IssueDigTabs, IssueBlockerSpotlight, WorkspaceCard, ReviewVerificationCard, AgentActivityCards, IssueMetricStrip, IssueStatusBand, spotlight.ts), nor of PlanMapCard.tsx, PickupGateCard.tsx or agentsLane.module.css.
- No edit to IssueActionMenu/*, the action registry, NeedsYouSlot.tsx, IssueDetailShell.tsx, Stage/IssueOverview.tsx or Stage/cockpit/MissionConversationTab.tsx.
- No server, route, contract, store-shape or query-hook change; no new HTTP route.
- No reading of ?agent= in the Stage tab and no writing of the Stage tab value to the URL.
- No row added to or removed from ISSUE_VIEW_INVENTORY or DENSITY_SECTIONS; no edit to densitySections.ts.
- No .skip, skipIf or .only, no new test that reads a source file, no file-size allowlist raise.

autoDecisions.summary: Set plan.metadata.sizeJustification instead of splitting into more sibling issues.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue is already the third slice of an operator split, and the flip, deletions, inventory re-homing and docs are inseparable.
